🚨🇲🇽 SHEINBAUM TO TRUMP: NO TO ICE TRAFFIC-STOP DETENTIONS

Trump ordered ICE to resume detaining migrants at traffic stops. Sheinbaum said no. "If a person must be deported under US law, then do it with respect for human rights," she answered, refusing to let irregular migration be treated as a crime — days after Mexico filed criminal complaints over the deaths of its nationals in ICE custody.

🚨🇲🇽 PAN ICON JAILED IN ALTIPLANO OVER MEXICO'S BIGGEST FUEL-SMUGGLING NETWORK

A PAN icon just landed in maximum security. Ernesto Ruffo — the party's first governor of Baja California — is in Altiplano, accused by the FGR of running the largest fuel-smuggling network ever detected in Mexico: Texas gasoline moved across the border by rail with only 10% of each tank car declared to customs. Prosecutor Ernestina Godoy puts the treasury damage at over 4 billion pesos.

🇲🇽📈 MEXICO'S MORTGAGE PORTFOLIO HITS RECORD 1.5 TRILLION PESOS

Mexico's mortgage credit balance reached 1.513 trillion pesos in May — a record since Banco de México began keeping the figure — up 20.6% in three years. Commercial banks project another 3–5% of growth through 2026, with delinquency at a healthy 3.11% and used homes now making up half of all purchases. The "two-speed economy" the financial press keeps predicting still hasn't shown up in the numbers. (El Economista)

🇲🇽🇵🇸 MEXICO SIGNS PACT TO PROTECT PALESTINIAN CULTURE

Mexico joined 28 other nations in Madrid to sign the "Pact for the Resilience of Palestinian Culture" — a commitment to protect and rebuild the libraries, museums, and monuments erased under military destruction, and to channel funds and political backing to Palestinian creators. Spain's culture minister Ernest Urtasun put it plainly: "to create is also a form of resistance." Mexico signs; the empire arms the bulldozers.

🚨🇲🇽 MEXICAN KILLED FLEEING ICE IN FLORIDA — 17TH DEATH

A Mexican national was killed on July 14 while trying to flee an ICE operation in Florida, struck by a car as he ran. Sheinbaum confirmed the death today and folded it into Mexico's legal action against the United States: 17 Mexicans are now dead in this campaign — 14 in ICE custody, 3 during raids. "Migration should not be criminalized per se," she said, days after Trump reactivated the transit-detention sweeps she has publicly rejected.

🇲🇽🌎 105 MEXICAN QUEEN ANTS SEIZED IN TOYS BOUND FOR LAOS

Profepa intercepted 105 live queen ants of the Mexican genus Pogonomyrmex — hidden inside plastic toys in Jalisco and falsely declared "collectible figures" — as they were about to ship to Laos. A parcel worker flagged the package; 87 surviving ants were released back into the Cerro Viejo protected reserve. Biopiracy is trafficking too, and this time it was caught at the counter.

🇲🇽🌎 ITALY RETURNS 27 PRE-COLUMBIAN PIECES — 840+ HOME SINCE 2013

Italy just handed 27 pre-Columbian archaeological and paleontological pieces back to Mexico — three Teotihuacan heads (200 BC–650 AD) found in a Milan inheritance, Early Classic Maya terracotta figurines seized in Rome — all pulled from the international art-trafficking trade by the Carabineri. At the Rome embassy, Ambassador Genaro Lozano noted more than 840 pieces have come home since 2013, under Sheinbaum's "Mi Patrimonio No Se Vende" campaign. INAH catalogs them as the inalienable property of the Nation.

🚨🇲🇽 FIRST PAN GOVERNOR IN MEXICAN HISTORY ARRESTED FOR FUEL SMUGGLING

Ernesto Ruffo — the PAN's very first opposition governor, elected in Baja California in 1989 and paraded for decades as the clean face of Mexico's right — was arrested today by the FGR for organized crime and huachicol fiscal. Prosecutors say the 74-year-old was majority shareholder of Ingemar, a firm tied to smuggling more than 15 million liters of US fuel into Mexico. The very racket the 4T is dismantling, built into the origin myth of the "honest" opposition.
